correctness.rationale: For all integer a,b>=2 and every strictly interior (i,j), the h_j<=i<=h_{j+1} visit condition is exact; avoiding it yields two disjoint lattice intervals. Flips toggle one cell, the meet-and-join route is a constructive shortest path, and binomial cuts enumerate both intervals. Rank differences yield the stated exact diameters and cube dimensions. The standalone geometric adjacency and breadth-first search verifier passed 208 parameter/fault instances and 519072 ordered-pair distance checks; finite tests corroborate a complete general proof.

value.rationale: The entire infinite two-parameter family and every interior failure location are classified. Exact route-state counts, all-pairs shortest rerouting, sharp relocation diameters and minimum cube coordinates quantify resilience of shortest routing under a single site fault. These natural invariants are needed to assess route flexibility; the theorem does not rely on arbitrary parameter slices.
